name: Reliance Power Ltd
about: Reliance Power has been established to develop, construct and operate power projects both in India as well as internationally. The Company on its own and through its subsidiaries has a large portfolio of power generation capacity, both in operation as well as capacity under development. [1]
keyPoints:
Capacity
The company’s generation capacity stands at 5,945 MW, including 5,760 MW of thermal capacity and 185 MW of renewable energy-based capacity. [1]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.93 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 93.2 to 73.2 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.05% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -9.68% over last 3 years.
